metadata.title: STAT-Secure entity triage playbook
metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel entity-triggered playbook that runs the STAT-Secure triage modules relevant to one entity type, scores the result, comments on the incident, and optionally raises severity on a High band.
Name of the Logic App. One playbook is deployed per entity type.
Sentinel entity type this playbook is triggered on. Deploy the template again for each additional type.
Name of the EXISTING Logic Apps API connection (and custom connector) for the STAT-Secure Function App, in this resource group.
Lookback window for the Related Alerts module (server-clamped to 30).
If true, a High risk band sets incident severity to High and adds the tag STAT-Secure-HighRisk.

Require_Incident_Context.description: STAT-Secure modules are scoped to an incident. Run this playbook from an entity inside an incident (incident > Entities > Run playbook), not from the entity page.

STAT-Secure entity triage — @{parameters('EntityType')}: @{replace(replace(replace(string(outputs('Compose_Entity')?['Value']), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')}
